skill.summary: MemPalace memory system for OpenClaw/XClaw/WorkBuddy. Archive AI conversations to local long-term storage with semantic search. Commands: /mem-arc (archive),...

latestVersion.changelog: v1.6.0: CRITICAL PATH FIX - archive.ps1 now uses 'python -m mempalace' instead of bare 'mempalace' command to avoid broken .exe shim. config.py auto-detects skill root via .skill_root marker file written by archive.ps1. All paths confirmed writing to skill/palace_data/ (NOT ~/.mempalace). archive: 0.36s, search: 344ms. Based on https://github.com/milla-jovovich/mempalace
